details.en-US: The full build depends on Firebase libraries, the Google Services Gradle plugin, and Google Play services ML Kit subject segmentation.

Active remote paths include Reddit, Wallhaven, Bing, Pexels, Pixabay, Wikimedia Commons, NASA APOD, Lemmy, Open-Meteo, Stability, Firebase community services, and YouTube in GitHub-channel builds. Freesound, SoundCloud, Audius, Openverse, and ccMixter entries document legacy attribution only and are not active feeds.
Aura does not use automatic analytics or crash reporting. Diagnostics export is local-only and user-initiated.
Aura has no ads, ad SDKs, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.
The full build is not entirely dependent on one irreplaceable service; provider switches and local/bundled flows leave core personalization usable when individual services are disabled.

proprietaryDependencyMarkers.disclosure: Google Services Gradle plugin is applied only when the requested Gradle tasks are not FOSS-only.
Firebase BoM coordinates community Auth, RTDB, Storage, Functions, and App Check libraries.
Anonymous Firebase identity backs community features.
Realtime Database backs community metadata, votes, reports, follows, blocks, and shares.
Firebase Storage stores community upload blobs.
Callable Functions are the planned enforced write path for community actions.
Play Integrity App Check providers are installed for release community calls.
Google Play services ML Kit subject segmentation powers subject-aware wallpaper features.

permissions.name: android.permission.SET_WALLPAPER
permissions.purpose: Apply selected images as device wallpapers.
permissions.disclosure: Needed for the core wallpaper personalization flow.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
permissions.purpose: Assign ringtone, notification, and alarm sounds when the user chooses an apply action.
permissions.disclosure: Protected system setting used only after explicit user action.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
permissions.purpose: Restore previously applied ringtone, notification, and alarm choices after device boot.
permissions.disclosure: Reviewed boot receiver only restores user-selected sound assignments; wallpaper rotation triggers do not start at boot.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.purpose: Record a local sound clip for optional community sound upload.
permissions.disclosure: Requested only when the user starts recording.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.purpose: Load remote wallpaper, sound, video, weather, community, and provider metadata.
permissions.disclosure: Required for online providers and community features.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.purpose: Detect network availability for online provider and background work behavior.
permissions.disclosure: Used to avoid poor network behavior and report source state.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.purpose: Legacy Android storage compatibility for saving media on older OS versions.
permissions.disclosure: Scoped by platform version; modern flows use scoped storage.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
permissions.purpose: Run active media and wallpaper operations that require foreground service behavior.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK
permissions.purpose: Support foreground audio preview/playback service behavior.
permissions.disclosure: Used for active audio playback controls.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
permissions.purpose: Support special-use foreground service behavior for wallpaper/media features.

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.purpose: Show foreground service, download, and scheduled wallpaper notifications.
permissions.disclosure: Requested only where the OS requires notification permission.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.purpose: Enable optional weather wallpaper effects using approximate location.
permissions.disclosure: Optional weather feature; shared only with the reviewed weather endpoint when enabled.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS
permissions.purpose: Assign a selected ringtone to the contact chosen through Android's picker.
permissions.disclosure: Used only after explicit contact ringtone action; contact selection stays local to the device.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY
permissions.purpose: Inspect Do Not Disturb priority-caller rules for per-contact ringtone guidance.
permissions.disclosure: Used locally to explain whether a selected contact can ring during Do Not Disturb; Aura does not change the user's policy without an explicit settings action.

Lemmy wallpaper community discovery provider using public lemmy.world posts.
Legacy attribution only; no active Openverse audio feed is requested.
Legacy attribution only; no active Freesound feed is requested.

Legacy attribution only; no active ccMixter feed is requested.

YouTube search/extraction path for sounds and videos; provider switch available.

notes: Use the signed GitHub Release APK and checksum.
Include anti-feature details at least in en-US.
Disclose Firebase/Google Play services dependencies and remote provider network services.
Run the two-root FOSS reproducibility check and retain both APK digests before requesting reproducible-build adoption.
Do not claim F-Droid mainline availability until release/source-build metadata and owner review pass.
